title: Which is better: Buying or renting a home? - Ella Feldman
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】買房和租房哪個比較好？ - 艾拉費爾德曼（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Morgan and her twin sister Lisa have been inseparable since birth.
cues.en: Morgan and her twin sister Lisa have been inseparable since birth.
cues.zh: 摩根和她的雙胞胎妹妹麗莎從出生起就形影不離。

cues.text: So nobody was surprised when they moved into identical houses right next to each other.
cues.en: So nobody was surprised when they moved into identical houses right next to each other.
cues.zh: 因此，當他們搬進彼此相鄰的相同房屋時，沒有人感到驚訝。

cues.text: The only difference?
cues.en: The only difference?
cues.zh: 唯一的差別是什麼？

cues.text: Morgan bought her house, while Lisa is renting hers.
cues.en: Morgan bought her house, while Lisa is renting hers.
cues.zh: 摩根買了她的房子，而麗莎租了她的房子。

cues.text: For generations, conventional wisdom has been that home ownership
cues.en: For generations, conventional wisdom has been that home ownership
cues.zh: 幾個世代以來，傳統觀念一直認為擁有住房

cues.text: is financially better than renting.
cues.en: is financially better than renting.
cues.zh: 經濟上比租房要好。

cues.text: But let’s follow the twins and see how things play out over the years,
cues.en: But let’s follow the twins and see how things play out over the years,
cues.zh: 但讓我們跟隨這對雙胞胎，看看這些年來事情是如何發展的，

cues.text: based on historical trends in the US.
cues.en: based on historical trends in the US.
cues.zh: 根據美國的歷史趨勢。

cues.text: As Morgan and Lisa move into their two-bedroom houses,
cues.en: As Morgan and Lisa move into their two-bedroom houses,
cues.zh: 當摩根和麗莎搬進他們的兩房房子時，

cues.text: their upfront costs look a little different.
cues.en: their upfront costs look a little different.
cues.zh: 他們的前期成本看起來有點不同。

cues.text: Morgan buys her house for $400,000.
cues.en: Morgan buys her house for $400,000.
cues.zh: 摩根以 40 萬美元買下了她的房子。

cues.text: Like most buyers, she takes out a mortgage— a loan that she'll pay back to a lender over time with interest.
cues.en: Like most buyers, she takes out a mortgage— a loan that she'll pay back to a lender over time with interest.
cues.zh: 和大多數買家一樣，她申請了抵押貸款，隨著時間的推移，她將連本帶利地償還給貸款人。

cues.text: For this, she needs to make a down payment— a lump sum that’s some percentage of the total home price.
cues.en: For this, she needs to make a down payment— a lump sum that’s some percentage of the total home price.
cues.zh: 為此，她需要支付首付——這筆金額佔總房價的一定比例。

cues.text: Between Morgan’s 10% down payment and a few extra fees, known as closing costs,
cues.en: Between Morgan’s 10% down payment and a few extra fees, known as closing costs,
cues.zh: 摩根 10% 的首付和一些額外費用（稱為成交成本）之間，

cues.text: Morgan spends a total of $50,000.
cues.en: Morgan spends a total of $50,000.
cues.zh: 摩根總共花費了 50,000 美元。

cues.text: Next door, Lisa signs a 12-month lease to rent her house for $1,800 a month.
cues.en: Next door, Lisa signs a 12-month lease to rent her house for $1,800 a month.
cues.zh: 麗莎在隔壁簽訂了一份為期 12 個月的租約，以每月 1,800 美元的價格出租她的房子。

cues.text: To get her keys, she’ll also pay a security deposit,
cues.en: To get her keys, she’ll also pay a security deposit,
cues.zh: 為了拿到鑰匙，她還要支付押金，

cues.text: bringing her total to $3,600— just a fraction of Morgan’s payment.
cues.en: bringing her total to $3,600— just a fraction of Morgan’s payment.
cues.zh: 這使得她的總金額達到 3,600 美元——只是摩根付款的一小部分。

cues.text: Five years in, Morgan and Lisa have added a few more members to the family.
cues.en: Five years in, Morgan and Lisa have added a few more members to the family.
cues.zh: 五年後，摩根和麗莎為這個家庭增添了更多成員。

cues.text: Lisa’s rent has been steadily climbing, about 2% every year.
cues.en: Lisa’s rent has been steadily climbing, about 2% every year.
cues.zh: 麗莎的租金一直在穩步上漲，每年上漲約 2%。

cues.text: Her monthly rent is now over $2,000, including a new pet fee.
cues.en: Her monthly rent is now over $2,000, including a new pet fee.
cues.zh: 她的月租金現在超過 2,000 美元，其中包括新的寵物費。

cues.text: This brings her five year total to around $112,000.
cues.en: This brings her five year total to around $112,000.
cues.zh: 這使她五年的總收入達到約 112,000 美元。

cues.text: Meanwhile, Morgan’s still paying off her mortgage, a 30-year loan with a fixed interest rate of 6%.
cues.en: Meanwhile, Morgan’s still paying off her mortgage, a 30-year loan with a fixed interest rate of 6%.
cues.zh: 與此同時，摩根仍在償還抵押貸款，這是一筆 30 年期、固定利率 6% 的貸款。

cues.text: This type of long-term fixed-rate loan is common in the US,
cues.en: This type of long-term fixed-rate loan is common in the US,
cues.zh: 這種型別的長期固定利率貸款在美國很常見，

cues.text: though loans with adjustable rates over shorter periods
cues.en: though loans with adjustable rates over shorter periods
cues.zh: 儘管貸款利率可在短期內調整

cues.text: are much more typical in the rest of the world.
cues.en: are much more typical in the rest of the world.
cues.zh: 在世界其他地方更為典型。

cues.text: Longer mortgages lower monthly payments by spreading them over an extended period.
cues.en: Longer mortgages lower monthly payments by spreading them over an extended period.
cues.zh: 期限較長的抵押貸款透過延長期限來降低每月還款額。

cues.text: Morgan's monthly total, including taxes and insurance, is around $2,500 per month.
cues.en: Morgan's monthly total, including taxes and insurance, is around $2,500 per month.
cues.zh: 摩根每月的總收入（包括稅金和保險）約為每月 2,500 美元。

cues.text: But a large fraction of early payments goes towards interest.
cues.en: But a large fraction of early payments goes towards interest.
cues.zh: 但提前付款的很大一部分都用於支付利息。

cues.text: So five years in, she’s spent $150,000 on her property—
cues.en: So five years in, she’s spent $150,000 on her property—
cues.zh: 五年來，她在自己的房產上花了 15 萬美元——

cues.text: $38,000 more than Lisa.
cues.en: $38,000 more than Lisa.
cues.zh: 比麗莎多了 38,000 美元。

cues.text: Despite this, she's only chipped about $25,000 off her mortgage.
cues.en: Despite this, she's only chipped about $25,000 off her mortgage.
cues.zh: 儘管如此，她只減少了大約 25,000 美元的抵押貸款。

cues.text: The good news for Morgan is that the market has changed
cues.en: The good news for Morgan is that the market has changed
cues.zh: 對摩根來說，好訊息是市場已經發生變化

cues.text: and interest rates have dropped, allowing her to refinance.
cues.en: and interest rates have dropped, allowing her to refinance.
cues.zh: 利率下降，使她能夠進行再融資。

cues.text: Basically, she takes out a new mortgage at the lower interest rate
cues.en: Basically, she takes out a new mortgage at the lower interest rate
cues.zh: 基本上，她以較低的利率申請新的抵押貸款

cues.text: to replace her old one.
cues.en: to replace her old one.
cues.zh: 來代替她的舊的。

cues.text: Her new rate is 5%, bringing her total monthly cost down to around $2,300.
cues.en: Her new rate is 5%, bringing her total monthly cost down to around $2,300.
cues.zh: 她的新費率為 5%，每月總費用降至 2,300 美元左右。

cues.text: 15 years in, Lisa’s rent now exceeds Morgan’s monthly payments.
cues.en: 15 years in, Lisa’s rent now exceeds Morgan’s monthly payments.
cues.zh: 15 年後，麗莎的租金現在超過了摩根的每月付款。

cues.text: But this isn’t the only cost to consider.
cues.en: But this isn’t the only cost to consider.
cues.zh: 但這並不是唯一需要考慮的成本。

cues.text: During an intense storm season, flash floods hit their neighborhood.
cues.en: During an intense storm season, flash floods hit their neighborhood.
cues.zh: 在強烈的風暴季節，山洪襲擊了他們的社群。

cues.text: As a homeowner, Morgan pays for repairs, while Lisa lets her landlord handle everything.
cues.en: As a homeowner, Morgan pays for repairs, while Lisa lets her landlord handle everything.
cues.zh: 作為房主，摩根支付維修費用，而麗莎讓房東處理一切。

cues.text: At this point, Morgan has spent over $500,000 on her house,
cues.en: At this point, Morgan has spent over $500,000 on her house,
cues.zh: 至此，摩根已經在她的房子上花了超過 50 萬美元，

cues.text: while Lisa has paid around $380,000.
cues.en: while Lisa has paid around $380,000.
cues.zh: 而麗莎則支付了約 38 萬美元。

cues.text: After 30 years, Morgan is finally done paying off her mortgage.
cues.en: After 30 years, Morgan is finally done paying off her mortgage.
cues.zh: 三十年後，摩根終於還清了房貸。

cues.text: To get there, she spent about $1 million,
cues.en: To get there, she spent about $1 million,
cues.zh: 為了到達那裡，她花了大約100萬美元，

cues.text: including the price of the house, interest, taxes, and insurance.
cues.en: including the price of the house, interest, taxes, and insurance.
cues.zh: 包括房價、利息、稅金和保險。

cues.text: But she's also had to pay for repairs and upkeep, bringing her total to $1.4 million.
cues.en: But she's also had to pay for repairs and upkeep, bringing her total to $1.4 million.
cues.zh: 但她還必須支付維修和保養費用，使她的總費用達到 140 萬美元。

cues.text: Meanwhile, Lisa’s rent is now $3,300 a month,
cues.en: Meanwhile, Lisa’s rent is now $3,300 a month,
cues.zh: 與此同時，麗莎的租金現在是每月 3,300 美元，

cues.text: and she's spent around $900,000 in rent.
cues.en: and she's spent around $900,000 in rent.
cues.zh: 她的房租花費約 90 萬美元。

cues.text: But before we calculate final tallies, there’s one more cost to consider: opportunity cost.
cues.en: But before we calculate final tallies, there’s one more cost to consider: opportunity cost.
cues.zh: 但在我們計算最終結果之前，還需要考慮一項成本：機會成本。

cues.text: When Morgan chose to spend $40,000 on a down payment,
cues.en: When Morgan chose to spend $40,000 on a down payment,
cues.zh: 當摩根選擇花 40,000 美元支付首付時，

cues.text: she missed out on putting that $40,000 into a stable, diversified retirement account.
cues.en: she missed out on putting that $40,000 into a stable, diversified retirement account.
cues.zh: 她錯過了將這 4 萬美元存入穩定、多元化的退休帳戶的機會。

cues.text: That’s what Lisa did, and it’s grown into $500,000.
cues.en: That’s what Lisa did, and it’s grown into $500,000.
cues.zh: 麗莎就是這麼做的，後來它的收入成長到了 50 萬美元。

cues.text: Morgan’s not sweating it, because her home turned out to be a pretty good investment,
cues.en: Morgan’s not sweating it, because her home turned out to be a pretty good investment,
cues.zh: 摩根並不擔心，因為事實證明她的房子是一項相當不錯的投資，

cues.text: as it's now worth $1.3 million.
cues.en: as it's now worth $1.3 million.
cues.zh: 因為它現在價值 130 萬美元。

cues.text: In the end, Morgan spent $1.4 million on a $1.3 million house,
cues.en: In the end, Morgan spent $1.4 million on a $1.3 million house,
cues.zh: 最後摩根花了140萬美元買了一棟價值130萬美元的房子，

cues.text: putting her at a loss of $100,000.
cues.en: putting her at a loss of $100,000.
cues.zh: 讓她損失了10萬美元。

cues.text: Lisa spent $900,000 in rent, but made $460,000 in investments,
cues.en: Lisa spent $900,000 in rent, but made $460,000 in investments,
cues.zh: 麗莎花了 90 萬美元的租金，但投資了 46 萬美元，

cues.text: putting her at a total loss of $440,000.
cues.en: putting her at a total loss of $440,000.
cues.zh: 使她總共損失了 44 萬美元。

cues.text: In this situation, Morgan came out on top.
cues.en: In this situation, Morgan came out on top.
cues.zh: 在這種情況下，摩根脫穎而出。

cues.text: Plus, she’s paid off her mortgage, so she only needs to pay taxes, insurance, and maintenance costs going forward.
cues.en: Plus, she’s paid off her mortgage, so she only needs to pay taxes, insurance, and maintenance costs going forward.
cues.zh: 另外，她已經還清了抵押貸款，因此她只需要支付未來的稅金、保險和維護費用。

cues.text: But Lisa won out in other ways.
cues.en: But Lisa won out in other ways.
cues.zh: 但麗莎在其他方面取得了勝利。

cues.text: She had lower monthly expenses for over 10 years, which allowed her to spend on hobbies and travel.
cues.en: She had lower monthly expenses for over 10 years, which allowed her to spend on hobbies and travel.
cues.zh: 十多年來，她每個月的開支較低，這使她可以把錢花在愛好和旅行上。

cues.text: In another scenario, she might have put that extra cash into retirement
cues.en: In another scenario, she might have put that extra cash into retirement
cues.zh: 在另一種情況下，她可能會將多餘的現金投入退休金

cues.text: or investments and allowed it to grow.
cues.en: or investments and allowed it to grow.
cues.zh: 或投資並使其成長。

cues.text: And Lisa wasn't tied to one location.
cues.en: And Lisa wasn't tied to one location.
cues.zh: 麗莎不限於某個地點。

cues.text: In fact, she just got a job opportunity in a new city
cues.en: In fact, she just got a job opportunity in a new city
cues.zh: 事實上，她剛剛在一個新城市找到了工作機會

cues.text: and is finally feeling ready to branch out.
cues.en: and is finally feeling ready to branch out.
cues.zh: 並終於準備好拓展業務了。
